function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing one with the specified content, ensuring the directory exists.

path.description: Absolute or relative directory path where the file will be stored. Existing sub‑directories will be created if necessary.

filename.description: Name of the file, including its extension (e.g., main.py, config.json).

content.description: The full text content to write to the file.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Retrieve the full text content of a file located at the specified path.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the target file.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute an arbitrary shell command and return its stdout, stderr, and exit code.

command.description: The full shell command to run, e.g., "ls -l".
